name: Helmi Fakhriandi Rachman
title: Backend engineer · payments & integrations
summary: Hi, I'm Helmi 👋 I've spent the last six years building payment systems for Indonesia's ATM Bersama network: ISO 8583 switching, QRIS, and the tooling that helps banks get certified. These days I'm also connecting a telecom client's project system to Oracle Fusion ERP. I like writing the test first, making slow reports fast, and handing over code the next person enjoys working on.

highlights.title: Payments, end to end
highlights.text: ISO 8583 switching, QRIS and payment gateways for the ATM Bersama network since 2020.

highlights.title: Integrations
highlights.text: Connecting a telecom client's project management system to Oracle Fusion ERP, from API work to go-live data loads.

highlights.title: Test-first
highlights.text: About 3,000 automated tests across two projects, written before the code with JUnit and Jest.

highlights.title: Mentoring
highlights.text: Handed my QRIS platform to two developers and now review their code.

wins.title: Excel export that used to time out
wins.before: 16.5 min, cut off at the 15-min gateway limit
wins.detail: Purchase-order export of 20,580 rows, about 60× faster. Peak memory at 58k rows went from 1,591 MB (the server was restarting the app at 1.5 GB) to 630 MB.

wins.title: Go-live data load into Oracle Fusion ERP
wins.detail: Built a parallel load runner (up to 8 lanes) for 12,981 purchase orders: 99.8% of files fully loaded, a backup and rollback script for every step, and one bad run rolled back safely.

wins.title: The query eating half the database
wins.before: 49% of DB time, queries up to the 1-hour timeout
wins.after: ≤ 3.5 s per search, in staging tests
wins.detail: Added a vendor index and capped the query behind a picker screen; results identical in 182 of 182 checks.

wins.title: Shipping steadily, test-first
wins.detail: Across 98 tickets, with 530 test files (about 2,650 test cases) written before the code: about 1 in 5 test files in the codebase.

experience.company: Pusat Ilmu Komputer Universitas Indonesia (Pusilkom UI) — vendor developer for Artajasa (ATM Bersama Network)
bullets: As the main engineer, designed and built a UAT automation and certification platform for ATM Bersama QRIS in Java 17, Spring Boot, Thymeleaf, JPA, PostgreSQL and jPOS (311 of 371 commits; about 39,000 lines in the codebase). Its sandbox host simulator runs an ISO 8583 TCP server and a JWT and HMAC-secured REST API, converts JSON to ISO 8583, and is covered by 766 JUnit tests. The tool replaces manual tests and writes the UAT report automatically.
Handed the platform to two developers in Aug 2026 and now mentor them and review their code.

Since Aug 2026, building Oracle Fusion ERP integration for a telecom client's project management system in Node.js, Express.js, Knex, PostgreSQL and React. Shipped 669 commits to production in 11 weeks (455 back end, 214 front end), all test-first with Claude Code: 530 test files with about 2,650 test cases.

Ran the go-live data migration: built a parallel load runner and loaded about 27,000 ERP files (about 2 million rows for 12,981 purchase orders) in 4 days, with a backup and tested rollback for every step. Made a 20,580-row Excel export 60x faster (16.5 minutes to 15.5 seconds, memory 1.6 GB to 630 MB) and fixed the query behind 49% of production database time (up to 1 hour down to under 4 seconds in staging tests).

2025 – 2026: main developer (192 of 322 commits) of a bill-hosting portal for billers in Spring Boot, Thymeleaf, Spring Security, Oracle and PostgreSQL. Built bill upload and validation, payment monitoring, settlement and reconciliation reports, QR code images for payment URLs and broadcast notifications. Fixed about 80 security code review findings (CSP, CSRF, OWASP output encoding, session expiry, Tomcat upgrade).

2022 – 2025: main developer (72 of 102 commits) of an e-money back office in Laravel and PostgreSQL, with maker-checker approvals, fraud and blacklist controls and account lockout. Also built settlement and reconciliation features for a disbursement system in Yii 1.1, Oracle and MySQL, with JasperReports and a Java reconciliation scheduler.

2020 – 2025: built ISO 8583 switching and payment gateway proxy features in Java over TCP sockets in a microservice setup (separate back-end, worker, front-end, proxy, payment and disbursement APIs). Also built a dashboard for transactions worth billions of rupiah.

Debugged and tuned slow reports to cut report and page load times from 15–30 minutes to under 5 minutes on up to one million rows of daily data. Fixed 10 to 50 penetration test findings per project, including all high and critical issues.
Maintained core APIs and integrated third-party APIs, including SOAP services, as part of the integration team.
